(230965) 2004 XA
192
is a
Kuiper-belt
object with a diameter of
339
+120
−95
km
. It has an
absolute magnitude
of approximately 4.42, and albedo around 26%. It was discovered on 12 December 2004 at
Palomar Observatory
.
It is currently at 35.8 AU from the Sun, near its
perihelion
.
